title: Pan-Seared Smoked Trout with German Beer Batter
description: A traditional German dish featuring pan-seared smoked trout coated in a crispy beer batter. Perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: beer
ingredients.notes: Any German beer, such as Weissbier or Pilsner

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet with 1/2 cup of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Season the trout fillets with salt and pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix together flour, beer, eggs, and buttermilk to create the beer batter.
Coat each trout fillet with the beer batter, making sure to coat evenly.
Carefully place the battered trout fillets in the preheated skillet and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the trout from the skillet and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
